description: Patent Strategy Pack — Both sides of a blocking patent in one call: pre-priority-date prior art charted against every claim element, and an all-elements freedom-to-operate map with three engineering design-arounds. Runs prior-art-invalidator ($1.00) + patent-design-around ($2.00) in one paid call for 20% less than buying them separately. Charged only when every member succeeds.

annualRevenueUsd.description: Annual revenue that depends on the product; sizes the dollar exposure in the headline.

assumedRoyaltyPct.description: Assumed running royalty as a percent of revenue, for the exposure illustration.

patentClaimsText.description: Numbered claims (at least the independent claims). Optional when patentNumber is given: the claims are then read from Google Patents.

patentNumber.description: Publication number such as US7629993B2. Used to read the claims from Google Patents when patentClaimsText is omitted.

priorityDate.description: Earliest effective filing/priority date, YYYY-MM-DD. Only works published strictly before it count. Optional when patentNumber is given; a supplied date wins over the Google Patents date and a disagreement is reported.

name: patent-strategy
